brief: Slovakia's systemic banks are private and publish nothing about procurement, so the supplier side is the only externally visible trace — and Slovak trade coverage confirms banks deliberately avoid naming IT suppliers, with several vendor references anonymised to 'a financial institution'. The richest sources are domestic vendors that do name projects (Softec's branch-system and digital-onboarding projects, Asseco CE's banking solution and reference pages plus its press-clipping archive, DATALAN and EEA reference lists), complemented by Big-4 SK newsrooms (KPMG, PwC, Deloitte leadership pages) whose partner appointments are themselves A5 events. Quantitative supplier-headcount tracking is best served by Profesia employer pages and FinStat company records for a fixed vendor watchlist, with Erste Digital's Bratislava/Kosice hubs the closest proxy for Slovenska sporitelna's programme staffing. Main gaps: Accenture/IBM/DXC SK have no located reference or newsroom source, Finastra shows no SK-named customer, and LinkedIn — where most FS-leadership posts appear — needs a compliant access route.
